_about: Test cases for For you (the picks and buttons), run by build/tests/run_foryou.mjs on the real page code, with the sheet's data in docs/assets/services.csv and a fixed date. Each says what the landing page's AI would have read (tags, town, prefs, safety, activities, terms: as in scenarios-tags.json and scenarios-activities.json) and good: record ids a support worker would be happy to see (the reference picks; others can be fine too). Checks for every case: nothing they can't go to (restricted_to), never two from one provider, an activity they asked for comes first or the page says it couldn't find one, nothing from another area when their own area has the same kind of thing.
